name: @sos-2/body-runtimes
description: SOS 2.0 Reference Body Runtimes (Work Order P8): THREE reference bodies behind the merged P5 Harness Contract, each advertising honest capabilities. (1) The DISPOSABLE CLOUD CODING/SHELL BODY — the reference implementation of the primary autonomous execution path: workspace read/write bounded by a @sos-2/sandbox environment, shell exec through a deterministic in-process shell simulator with an INJECTABLE command registry (no real process spawning), git operations as typed records, artifact capture, observation emission and a cursor-based event stream; leased through the P5 broker and isolated in a sandbox; its lifecycle is independent of any local-device presence (placement cloud). (2) The BROWSER/EVALUATOR BODY — capability-advertised browser journeys (open/interact) as typed records through an injectable browser port; the real browser bridge is a later-wave adapter; this body proves the contract. (3) THE GITHUB-AWARE PROJECT BODY — repository operations (branch/commit/PR) through the P4 provider-neutral GitHubPort with a sandbox-bounded staging workspace and typed network exchange records; honest NOT_YET_CONNECTED failures when no real credentials exist (never fabricated). Unsupported operations are typed UNSUPPORTED everywhere; sandbox boundary violations surface as truthful FAILED results carrying the typed denial. No real cloud accounts exist: all three are LOCAL REFERENCE RUNTIMES — deterministic, offline-testable, satisfying the SAME Harness Contract; real provider endpoints attach later through @sos-2/harness-adapters without contract change.
